title: Hatchers Pass Gold Mine Day or Evening Scenic and Narrated Drive
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: This is a great daytime or evening tour. If you are looking to explore and experience local history and see some of the sites that are north of Anchorage, Hatchers pass is a great opportunity! Take advantage of the long summer days in Alaska and go out on this excursion in the evening. This is a great sunset drive up 4000 feet in elevation. Along the way there is a good chance of spotting moose, seeing our wildflowers in the summer and there's always the possibility of seeing a black bear! Along the way I will tell you all about the exciting history of Alaska!
